overview: No anticheat in the 50-repo corpus runs a check on the global-entity (lightning) packet. The only genuine packet references are framework registrations: Artemis wraps PacketPlayOutSpawnEntityWeather as GPacketPlayServerSpawnEntityWeather and registers it at SERVER_PLAY + 69, and Negativity lists the packet in its PacketType enum. Every other corpus hit is keyword noise from the search term Lightning: strikeLightningEffect ban-punishment visuals in PeyangSuperbAntiCheat KickUtil, TruthfulAC Check and SafeguardAC ViolationHandler, and lightning-rod block-shape comments in NoCheatPlus. Lightning is ambient server weather with no client-trust signal, so nothing measures it.
